content: BGG thing XML includes <poll name="suggested_numplayers" title="User Suggested Number of Players" totalvotes="N"> elements. Each <results numplayers="N"> contains <result value="Best" numvotes="..." />, <result value="Recommended" numvotes="..." />, and <result value="Not Recommended" numvotes="..." /> children. BGG also has language dependence and game weight polls. In a Rails app, these should be parsed by the existing Bgg::XmlParser (Nokogiri) and stored as normalized rows (e.g., BggPoll and BggPollResult) or as a JSON column on BggThing, because the raw poll is small but query patterns are set-based (find best count for a game). Cache the raw BGG response in Solid Cache with the existing thing TTL (1 hour) and persist parsed poll data into the app database during import or thing enrichment jobs so the suggestion engine reads from the DB, not BGG.
